sources: Owner-approved twin cities gameplay, graphics and expansion roadmap, 14 November 2026
name: Irekha

lines.text: The boat stays light because the reeds can move a little. A tight seam is not the same as a rigid one.
I mend the outer bundles here. The living reed bed supplies the next repair without losing its bank.
You have seen how the roots hold the bank. Leave them their strip of water and we both keep our work.
